units.source_text: 无论是绉纱还是纱线，都要在碱水里泡浸一夜，第二天早晨再用水冲洗几遍，然后拧干曝晒。

en.t: Whether it was crepe cloth or thread, it had to be soaked overnight in lye, rinsed several times the next morning, then wrung out and spread in the sun to bleach.
This had to be repeated for several days.

units.source_text: 每当白绉快要晒干的时候，旭日初升，燃烧着璀璨的红霞，这种景色真是美不胜收，恨不能让南国的人们也来观赏。

en.t: Whenever the white crepe was almost dry, the rising sun would kindle a brilliant red glow, a sight so beautiful that one wished people from the southern provinces could come and see it too.
People in former times also wrote of it in this way.

units.source_text: 绉纱曝晒完毕，正是预报雪国的春天即将到来。

en.t: The end of the crepe bleaching was a sign that spring would soon come to the snow country.
